_readme: Two kinds of fix, both confirmed by a person, both outranking anything the script infers. 'corrections' move transactions off a cost code they were posted to by mistake. 'splits' carve estimate lines off a code onto a line of their own, for a budget that was estimated onto whatever code was nearest. Both match on the exact amount, so a rule that no longer matches the export is reported rather than applied silently.

corrections.reason: Siding subcontractor invoices billed against the framing budget.

splits.reason: Mobilization and lodging is not supervisor mileage. It was estimated onto that code for want of one of its own, and wants its own line.
